info.description: Single self-hosted workspace with owner sessions, invite-only roles, app-scoped agents and mutation audit. HTTP 202 queues a release; poll its ID. Preview mode is isolated/local only.

post.summary: Queue restart of one existing instance
post.description: Restarts the bound runtime without applying saved future configuration. Serialized with deployments and guarded by definition version and idempotency key. Uncertain dispatch enters attention.

post.summary: Retire highest instance ordinals and commit a lower desired count
post.description: Docker managed components only. Requires a lower positive count, definition version, and idempotency key. Stops selected instances without deleting resources or volumes; count changes only after all stops are confirmed. Configuration edits and other operations are blocked during retirement. Bindings remain reserved and can be reactivated by deployment.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-oap-session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly browser session. Writes require X-OAP-CSRF: 1 and a permitted Origin. Local HTTP uses oap-session instead.

retryable.description: A transient failure may be retried only after outcome inspection and with the same mutation key.

management.description: New existing-resource registrations always start observe-only. Omitted on existing managed definitions. Enable lifecycle management using the explicit handoff endpoint.

serviceEndpoints.description: Referenced component name to explicit operator-managed HTTP(S) endpoint. Required for Coolify connections; no credentials, query, or fragment.

env.description: Plain non-secret runtime variables. Coolify mutates only recorded OAP-owned production variables; unrelated and preview variables remain operator-managed.

services.description: Environment variable to component name. Uses application DNS on Docker or a supplied explicit endpoint; adopted targets require an explicit endpoint.

port.description: Web services require 1–65535. Workers require zero; observed resources may use zero when the operator reports no port.

hostPort.description: Zero adds no host port mapping. Existing operator routes may still expose the resource.

secretRefs.description: Runtime variable to immutable administrator-authorized secret reference. Values are never stored in definitions. OAP-owned workloads only; grants bind target, application, component and variable.

databaseEndpoint.description: Descriptive PostgreSQL endpoint without credentials, query or fragment; existing observe-only database only.

registryCredentialRef.description: Scoped private-image credential reference. Direct Docker only; operator login stays native.

ingress.description: Optional application routing. Omit or set null to save a desired withdrawal; a separate deployment removes previously published routes without deleting workloads.

applicationId.description: Existing OAP reservation, when present on discovery.

source.description: Pinned GitHub repository/commit/ref/delivery provenance supplied by the trusted source pipeline.

retired.description: Retained instance reserved for this application after confirmed stop.

workers.description: OAP-owned long-running image workers; no ports, public endpoints or HTTP overrides.

applicationIngress.description: Target has explicit host-owner standalone Caddy authority. Domain, peer identity and actual native readiness are verified during admission/execution.

reason.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters

state.description: Ignored on input; provider state is always observed

path.description: Local path, required for http; no URL, query or fragment

specification.description: Complete desired specification for create/configure/scale-down/remove-component. Removal deletes exactly one owned component from the definition after reviewed retirement; remaining fields stay unchanged.

requireReview.description: Optional exact owner review for ordinary actions. remove-component always requires exact human owner approval regardless of this flag.

path.description: Literal segment prefix; longest matching path wins.

component.description: Owned web component with a private port.

IngressDefinition.description: Application ingress requires an explicitly owner-configured standalone Caddy peer. Automatic provisioning and public ACME acceptance remain deferred.

DockerIngressAuthority.description: Host-owner configuration for one dedicated existing Caddy peer/domain. Not application-controlled.

publicAcme.description: Explicit host-owner public ACME authority; mutually exclusive with internalCa.

domains.description: Additional exact owner-authorized domains; no wildcard authority.

OperationQueueObservation.description: Observation-only dispatch evidence for this operation; missing or unavailable jobs never permit redispatch. Excludes raw errors, arguments and credentials.
